blurb: The Oak Harbor Marina offers 420 slips including open and covered permanent slips, guest moorage, limited side-tie moorage, and 96 dry storage sheds. Amenities include free Wi-Fi, showers, restrooms, laundry, ice, picnic tables, playground, waste oil and recycle bins, and a full service fuel dock. The marina is located about a mile from downtown Oak Harbor retailers, motels, and restaurants.
